sections.label: Upload Settings
sections.help: Which systems DCS-DTC types into the cockpit when uploading. Order: waypoints or route (pilot CDU), then radios. Upload.Route takes precedence over Upload.Waypoints. The page re-creates a null system.

sections.label: Waypoints
sections.help: CDU ACP waypoint database, sequence 1..200. Filled from the dashboard route. The page re-creates a null system, but a null Waypoints.Waypoints list crashes it.

sections.label: Route
sections.help: Which waypoints go into the CDU flight plan (FPLN) when Upload.Route is set. Only positions are entered. The page re-creates a null system; Route.Route must not be null.

sections.label: Radios
sections.help: Radio1 = UHF-1 (225.000-399.975), Radio2 = VHF-1 / ARC-186 (108.000-173.975 in the UI, the knob logic only reaches 30-159 MHz). 20 presets each, no guard. The page re-creates a null system; Radio1/Radio2 must not be null.

sections.label: Capture Settings
sections.help: Where points captured on the DCS F10 map (Ctrl+Shift+D dialog) are inserted into the waypoint list. App-side only, never uploaded. The page re-creates a null system.

fields.label: Aircraft code
fields.help: Always "CH47F". The loader picks the C# configuration type from this value; it must match the preset folder / Load page.

fields.label: Format version
fields.help: Always 2. A missing Version (or 1) together with a missing Upload sends the file to the V1 converter, which throws for this aircraft.

fields.label: Kneeboard notes
fields.help: Free text shown (and editable) in the in-game DCS-DTC kneeboard dialog (Ctrl+Shift+K). Not a system: Load/Save never copies it, only a whole preset file carries it.

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: Write all waypoints into the CDU waypoint database (number, position, elevation, name). Ignored when Upload.Route is true.

fields.label: Route
fields.help: Build the FPLN from the route selection (positions only). When true, Upload.Waypoints is ignored.

fields.label: Radios
fields.help: Program presets and manual frequency / preset selection for both radios.

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: Filled from the planned route: route point i -> Sequence i (1..N, unique, sorted), list order = fly order (the FPLN path uses list order for Use all). Max 200.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.help: ACP waypoint number 1..200, unique; typed into the CDU.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Required, never null (the uploader throws on null). Typed in full (not truncated) after a slash; only A-Z, 0-9 and "." are typed, spaces and other characters are dropped. Use short upper-case route point names.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "N 42°10.583’" (2-digit zero-padded degrees, U+00B0 degree sign, U+2019 minute mark). The CH-47F uploader slices the string by position (N4136.575E04136.014), so the exact padded format is mandatory.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "E 042°28.950’" (3-digit zero-padded degrees). The CH-47F uploader slices the string by position (N4136.575E04136.014), so the exact padded format is mandatory.

fields.label: Elevation
fields.help: Ground elevation of the point, integer feet MSL (editor range 0..30000). A minus sign is dropped when typed.

fields.label: Time over steerpoint
fields.help: HH:MM:SS or null; route TOT/ETA if the dashboard has one. Shown in the app and kneeboard only, never uploaded on this aircraft.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: True for route target points (shows "TGT" in the list and kneeboard). Not uploaded on this aircraft.

fields.label: Route
fields.help: RoutePage dereferences Route.Route, so it must not be null.

fields.label: Route selection
fields.help: RouteMode. 1 = every waypoint in list order; 2 = Route.Waypoints is [from, to] (inclusive sequences, swapped if reversed); 3 = Route.Waypoints is an ordered list of sequences (unknown ones skipped). 0 behaves like 1; the UI coerces it to 1 when opened. From the dashboard: 1 when the waypoint list IS the route; 2/3 when extra non-route points (alternates, FARPs) are also in the list.

fields.label: Route waypoints
fields.help: null for Use all. Use range: exactly [from, to] (1..200). Use specific: waypoint sequences in fly order, unique, 1..200 (UI: comma separated list).

fields.label: Waypoint sequence
fields.help: A waypoint Sequence present in Waypoints.Waypoints. For a dashboard route, list its sequences in fly order (Mode 3) or give [first, last] (Mode 2).

fields.label: UHF-1
fields.help: UHF radio programmed through the CDU.

fields.label: UHF-1 presets
fields.help: Preset channels, Number 1..20, one entry per used channel (null or [] when none). Ordered by Number when uploaded.

fields.label: Channel
fields.help: Preset channel number, unique within the radio. Required: RadioPreset has only a Number constructor.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Preset label; the uploader types the first 8 characters. Null when empty.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: UHF 225.000-399.975 MHz, 25 kHz steps. Invariant decimal with exactly 3 decimals, no leading zeros (e.g. "251.000").

fields.label: Manual frequency
fields.help: Frequency tuned when Mode = Frequency. UHF 225.000-399.975 MHz, 25 kHz steps.

fields.label: Selected preset
fields.help: Preset channel selected when Mode = Preset. Stored as a STRING ("1".."20") or null.

fields.label: Guard
fields.help: Guard receiver. Not offered by the UI for this aircraft and not uploaded; leave false.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: RadioMode: 1 = tune SelectedFrequency, 2 = select SelectedPreset. A new preset has 0 (no combo selection); the uploader then neither tunes nor selects. Set 1 or 2 explicitly.

fields.label: VHF-1 (ARC-186)
fields.help: ARC-186; Mode 1 turns the mode knob to manual and dials the frequency with the knobs, Mode 2 to preset.

fields.label: VHF-1 (ARC-186) presets
fields.help: Preset channels, Number 1..20, one entry per used channel (null or [] when none). Ordered by Number when uploaded.

fields.label: Channel
fields.help: Preset channel number, unique within the radio. Required: RadioPreset has only a Number constructor.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Preset label; the uploader types the first 8 characters. Null when empty.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: VHF 108.000-173.975 MHz in the UI, 25 kHz steps (last two decimals 00/25/50/75). The knob logic only reaches 30-159 MHz. Invariant decimal with exactly 3 decimals, no leading zeros (e.g. "251.000").

fields.label: Manual frequency
fields.help: Frequency tuned when Mode = Frequency. VHF 108.000-173.975 MHz in the UI, 25 kHz steps (last two decimals 00/25/50/75). The knob logic only reaches 30-159 MHz.

fields.label: Selected preset
fields.help: Preset channel selected when Mode = Preset. Stored as a STRING ("1".."20") or null.

fields.label: Guard
fields.help: Guard receiver. Not offered by the UI for this aircraft and not uploaded; leave false.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: RadioMode: 1 = tune SelectedFrequency, 2 = select SelectedPreset. A new preset has 0 (no combo selection); the uploader then neither tunes nor selects. Set 1 or 2 explicitly.

fields.label: Navigation points

options.label: Add to end of the list
Add to end of the first gap

fields.help: SteerpointCaptureMode for captured non-target points. When the waypoint list comes from the dashboard route, leave 0 (append after the route) so captures in the cockpit do not overwrite route points.

fields.label: Target points

options.label: Add to the end of the list

fields.help: SteerpointCaptureMode for captured target points. The UI offers only end-of-list (0) and range (2); 1 is accepted on load but has no radio button. This aircraft has no "Add TGT" capture button, so this rarely matters.

fields.label: Navigation range start
fields.help: First sequence used when Navigation points = Add to specific range. A dashboard can set it to (last route sequence + 1) to keep captures clear of the route.

fields.label: Target range start
fields.help: First sequence used when Target points = Add to specific range.
